purpose: Separate conformance, semantic, downstream, toil, learning, and missingness dimensions.
rules: Mechanical lenses produce objective conformance observations, not semantic scores.
Semantic scoring uses independent committed ballots and key-anchored evidence.
Downstream utility uses one blind artifact and a common immutable task.
Minimize only toil; learning investment and Director strategic judgment are protected dimensions.
Missing or unavailable telemetry remains typed missingness.
